mapper.sql: id, name, skill_id, question_template, output_path, enabled, created_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skill_job (name, skill_id, question_template, output_path, enabled, created_by) VALUES (#{name}, #{skillId}, #{questionTemplate}, #{outputPath}, #{enabled}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE skill_job SET name=#{name}, skill_id=#{skillId}, question_template=#{questionTemplate}, output_path=#{outputPath}, enabled=#{enabled}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.sql: id, job_id, trigger_type, status, conversation_id, resolved_output_path, md_file_written, md_file_exists, error_msg, started_at, completed_at, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skill_job_execution (job_id, trigger_type, status, conversation_id, resolved_output_path, md_file_written, md_file_exists, error_msg, started_at, completed_at) VALUES (#{jobId}, #{triggerType}, #{status}, #{conversationId}, #{resolvedOutputPath}, #{mdFileWritten}, #{mdFileExists}, #{errorMsg}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE skill_job_execution SET status=#{status}, conversation_id=#{conversationId}, resolved_output_path=#{resolvedOutputPath}, md_file_written=#{mdFileWritten}, md_file_exists=#{mdFileExists}, error_msg=#{errorMsg}, started_at=#{startedAt}, completed_at=#{completedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE skill_job_execution SET status = 'FAILED', error_msg = '应用重启中断：进程退出时仍在运行', started_at = COALESCE(started_at, NOW()), completed_at = NOW() WHERE status IN ('RUNNING', 'PENDING')
